name: school_payments
summary: Fee bills, payment receipts, penalties, and privileged penalty waivers
description: Transactional payment layer for the school system: issues periodic fee bills with discount and penalty applied, records payments and receipts by cashiers, tracks accumulated late-payment penalties, and supports partial or full penalty waivers as a Manager/Director-only privilege with recorded approver and reason. Balance and paid status are maintained per bill.
author: Nexa
